system.description:
Starting at 18th level, your control over biological matter has reached its apex, no longer bound by earthly templates, you tap into the mythical genetics of Sage Beasts, being of legendary composition and mysterious history. You gain the following benefits;

When you apply Transfiguration to a hostile creature, you can choose to maintain concentration on it as if concentrating on a Jutsu, for up to 1 minute at no chakra cost, instead of it ending at the end of your next turn.

Additionally, you learn to transfigure creatures DNA to more closely match a Sage beast. You can choose from the new designation, Sage Beast.

| #### Transmogrified Biology - Transfiguration / Enhancement / Sage Beast: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to the Medical-Nins Channeled Healing bonus. If you are at full hit points, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to the same value. Also, you gain a +2 bonus to your critical threat range and once per turn, you can spend half your movement to select a space you can see within 60 feet that can hold you, teleporting to the chosen space. |

| Transmogrified Biology – Transfiguration / Penalty Options / Sage Beast. A transfigured (Sage Beast) creature suffers uncontrollable chakra overflow and physical instability. / At the beginning of a transfigured creatures turn, they take necrotic damage equal to the Medical Nin’s Channeled Healing bonus as their cellular structure continues to break down. / When the affected creature casts a jutsu, they must roll a d20. On a roll of 5 or more, they jutsu cast has its cost increased by an amount equal to the Medical Nin’s Channeled Healing bonus. |
